newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah steady amid sufficient liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah steady amid sufficient liquidity.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah remained steady against the dollar in slow late trading on Tuesday amid sufficient liquidity, dealers said.
"Overseas dollar selling was noted after the lunch break which helped keep sentiment on the local currency steady despite sufficient market liquidity," one foreign bank dealer said.
Another dealer said weekly tax-payments and earlier anticipation that the central bank was not likely to increase the fixing rate later on Tuesday also kept sentiment steady.
Dealers, however, said trading volume was thin due to the holiday mood ahead of year-end.
One-month swap was at 16.00/16.25, two at 30.00/31.00, three at 42.50/43.25 and six at 86.50/87.50 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,353/2,545 and the conversion band at 2,353/2,401 late on Tuesday as anticipated earlier.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2,353.25/53.50 against an opening of 2,353.00/54.00.
The foreign bank dealer said the spot rupiah rate was likely to range between 2,353.50 and 2,354.50 on Wednesday.
He said overnight swap edged up to 0.60/0.70 from an opening of 0.40/0.50 following the weekly tax-payments.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were last quoted at 2,353.25/53.60 and 2,352.00/53.00, respectively.
